ticks.note: Tick 1 enters the initial state of *each* region: `Off` in `Hall` and `Off` in `Porch`. The chart is in two states at once.
`hallButton`: the `Hall` region moves to `On`. `Porch` reacts too, in the same tick, but none of its transitions is enabled, so it stays in `Off`.
`porchButton`: now `Porch` moves to `On`; `Hall` stays where it is.
Both buttons are pressed (`porchButton` is still true from the last tick). Both regions react in this one tick: both lamps go off.
Neither button: both regions stay in `Off`.
